$comment: Fixture evals for eval-report, defined as JSON data: rich outputs (cards, lists, links). ../runner/run.mjs runs them against a fake model (../outputs.json).

cases.name: a weekend itinerary has one plan per day
cases.rule: Instructions, ‘Itineraries’: one section per day; adapt to the weather.
cases.input: Plan a weekend in Lisbon for two, mid-range budget, we love food.

checks.judge: suggests an indoor plan for the rainy day

cases.name: flight options show price, stops and times
cases.input: Cheapest flights London to Lisbon on 12 Dec, back 15 Dec.

cases.name: asks for dates before searching flights
cases.knownBug: Intermittent. The reply is a question card with no words at all (service.ts, endsReply).

cases.name: a visa question points to the official source
cases.input: Do I need a visa for Japan with a UK passport?

checks.judge: does not state rules as certain

cases.name: a hotel shortlist stays within budget
cases.input: Hotels in Porto under €120 a night, 3 nights from 20 Dec.

cases.name: weather is given for the trip dates, not today
cases.input: What will the weather be like in Rome from 3 to 6 January?

cases.name: a tool error is explained and retried once
cases.input: Book me the 9:40 to Lisbon on 12 Dec.

checks.judge: tells the buyer the search failed, without jargon
